limitations.ja: 対象方程式・境界条件・検証の範囲は解説章と各コードを確認してください。教育用例は汎用ソルバーの完成を意味しません。 追加固定例：Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。 追加固定例：任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。 追加固定例：有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
limitations.en: See the chapter and implementation for equations, boundaries and checked scope. Educational examples are not complete general-purpose solvers. Additional fixed examples: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials. Additional fixed examples: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed. Additional fixed examples: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

title.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

summary.ja: 実際の2D散乱場を進め、閉曲線Poynting流束と独立な円柱級数を比較します。
summary.en: Evolve the actual two-dimensional scattered fields and compare closed-contour Poynting power with an independent cylindrical series.

assumptions.ja: c=ε0=μ0=1。無限円柱のEz偏光、半径0.25、比誘電率2.25、真空波長1。6×6領域と4辺PML、明示的な節点階段状形状です。
assumptions.en: Use c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, an infinite cylinder with Ez polarization, radius 0.25, relative permittivity 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The 6 × 6 domain has four-side PML and an explicitly nodal staircase geometry.

algorithm.ja: Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。
algorithm.en: Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation.

validation.ja: 12/18/24点/波長、32周期の過渡除去と8周期の計測。2本の閉曲線、前後4周期、同じ全時間を進めた半振幅phasorと5保存時刻の真空対照を検査し、円柱級数の散乱幅と外部場を照合します。
validation.en: Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times. Compare scattering width and exterior fields with the cylindrical series.

limits.ja: Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
limits.en: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

title.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

summary.ja: 有限波束の実進行から複素r/t・R/T・直接散逸を求め、複素Fresnel参照と比較します。
summary.en: Measure complex r/t, power fractions and direct dissipation from actual finite-pulse evolutions and compare them with complex Fresnel slab references.

assumptions.ja: 周期y方向のky=4に制限した2D場、c=1。板[4,5]のε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。外側は真空、PEC端は[-24,36]、T=60です。
assumptions.en: Use a two-dimensional field restricted to periodic transverse wave number ky = 4 and c = 1. The slab [4, 5] has epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Outer vacuum ends at PEC caps [-24, 36]; T = 60.

algorithm.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。
algorithm.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

validation.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
validation.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

limits.ja: 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
limits.en: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

formulas: \varepsilon_\infty\partial_t\mathbf E=\nabla\times\mathbf H-\sigma\mathbf E-\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J

title.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
title.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

summary.ja: 80度の中心位相角を持つ有限波束をT=700まで進め、境界誤差を同格子の無PML参照から分離します。
summary.en: Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid.

assumptions.ja: c=1、均質Lorentz媒質ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12はPML内まで連続。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時に細分化します。垂直粗格子はpeak6、弱減衰細格子対照はpeak12。長さ64、層幅12、中心32、幅4、carrier6は固定です。
assumptions.en: Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed.

algorithm.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
algorithm.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

validation.ja: 3つの格子・層強度の同時細分化、垂直・弱減衰対照の5長時間計算。参照入力が全て不変なことを確認して同一byteの無PML参照を再利用します。旧13検査本体を保持し、policy・peak12直接仕事の2回帰を追加。全44長時間判定は不変です。
validation.en: Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.

limits.ja: 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
limits.en: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

formulas: \psi^n=b\psi^{n-1}+c(D^n+D^{n-1}),\quad b=\frac{1-s_x\Delta t/2}{1+s_x\Delta t/2},\quad c=\frac{-s_x\Delta t/2}{1+s_x\Delta t/2}

method_note.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
method_note.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

problem_name.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

title.ja: 誘電体円柱の外部級数と散乱幅
title.en: Exterior series and scattering width of a dielectric cylinder

note.ja: Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
note.en: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

problem_name.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

title.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸
title.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss

note.ja: 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
note.en: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

problem_name.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
problem_name.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

title.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照
title.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

note.ja: 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.
